title: Route-Length Credit in Wrong-Address Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Long delivery routes are taken into account when a wrong-address dispute on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts is decided.

**Which batch.** The disputed violation's batch is the batch named on the wrong-address violation under dispute. The estimated route miles are those shown on that batch's offer, as its record in Cartwise Shopper Batches carries them.

**Clause.** The route credit follows the estimated route miles on the disputed violation's batch offer: 12.0 miles or more give a route credit of 2 points; from 6.0 miles up to but not including 12.0 miles give 1 point; shorter routes give no credit.

| Estimated route miles on the offer | Route credit |
|---|---|
| 12.0 or more | 2 points |
| 6.0 up to, not including, 12.0 | 1 point |
| Under 6.0 | None |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical offers)

| Estimated miles | Credit |
|---|---|
| 12.0 | 2 points |
| 11.9 | 1 point |
| 6.0 | 1 point |
| 5.9 | None |

The figure is the estimate shown on the offer.
